meta.name: Plan study sessions from syllabus PDFs with Gemini, Google Calendar, and Sheets

name: Student Assignment Planner from Syllabus PDF with Gemini, Google Drive, Calendar, and Sheets

values.content:
=You are an academic data extraction assistant.

You will receive a full syllabus or academic document text. Your task is to extract all assignments, exams, quizzes, projects, labs, presentations, and any other graded academic activities.

IMPORTANT RULES:

* Output MUST be valid JSON only
* Do NOT include markdown, explanations, or extra text
* Do NOT wrap response in ``` or any formatting
* If no assignments exist, return: {"assignments": []}
* Do NOT invent exact dates; only infer when clearly possible
* If only partial date exists (month/day), assume current academic year and convert to YYYY-MM-DD
* Be accurate and conservative (do not hallucinate data)

You must return the following JSON structure:

{
"assignments": [
{
"title": "",
"due_date": "",
"description": "",
"estimated_hours": 0
}
]
}

FIELD RULES:

* title: short and clear name of task (exam, assignment, project, etc.)
* due_date: ISO format YYYY-MM-DD or null if not available
* description: short explanation of task
* estimated_hours: numeric estimate of effort (use best judgment if not specified)

INPUT SYLLABUS TEXT:
{{$json.cleanedText}}

parameters.content:
## Syllabus File Intake

This section starts the workflow on demand and fetches the latest syllabus PDF from your Google Drive. The manual trigger lets you test and run the process whenever you update the syllabus, while the Google Drive node reliably downloads the file as binary data for downstream processing.

## PDF Text Extraction
This section focuses on extracting and cleaning the textual content from the syllabus. The first Code node prepares or passes through the raw text extracted from the PDF, and the second Code node removes noise such as repeated spaces, line breaks, and headers so that the syllabus content becomes easier for the AI model to understand.

## AI Assignment Parsing
This section sends the cleaned syllabus text to the Gemini model to detect all assignments, quizzes, and exams with due dates. The Code node then parses the AI response, normalizes the due dates into a consistent ISO format, assigns a default course name, calculates priority based on urgency, and ensures estimated hours are numeric and usable for planning tasks.

## Calendar Study Scheduling

This section turns each assignment into a complete, calendar-ready study schedule. The Code node breaks estimated hours into multiple sessions before the due date, then both assignment deadlines and study sessions are created as Google Calendar events so students see exactly when to work and when each task is due.

## Logging And Summary

This final section combines all created events, converts them into a standardized row format, logs them into Google Sheets, and produces a compact summary. The Merge node collects both deadline and study session outputs, the Code node shapes them for the sheet, the Google Sheets node records everything, and the summary node counts events so you can quickly verify each planner run.

## How it works:
This workflow converts a syllabus PDF into a structured study and calendar plan for a student. It begins by manually triggering the flow and downloading the syllabus file from Google Drive. The PDF content is extracted and cleaned to remove formatting noise, then sent to a Gemini model that identifies all assignments and their due dates. A normalization step standardizes dates and estimates work hours. Based on these values, the workflow generates multiple weekly study sessions leading up to each deadline. Google Calendar events are then created for both the final due dates and each study session. All events are logged in Google Sheets, and a summary node counts how many assignments and sessions were created, giving clear visibility into each run and enabling easy troubleshooting or refinement of the study plan.
## Setup Steps:
1. Connect Google Drive, Google Calendar, Gemini, and Google Sheets credentials in n8n.
2. Configure the Google Drive node to download the correct syllabus PDF file.
3. Adjust the cleaning Code node to match your syllabus header and footer patterns.
4. Tune the Gemini prompt and check that it outputs valid JSON with assignments.
5. Customize the normalization logic for course name, default hours, and priorities.
6. Set desired study session length and time window in the study task generator node.
7. Point the Google Sheets node to your log spreadsheet and confirm column mapping.
